definitions.explanation: To display something conspicuously to impress others, often with a sense of boasting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見|み}せびらかしている。
examples.english: He's showing off his new car.

examples.japanese: ⟦SNS→SNS：05601_esuenuesu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧⟦ブランド→ブランド：05221_burando⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見|み}せびらかす⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: It's tacky to show off luxury brands on social media.

examples.japanese: ⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見|み}せびらかす⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{嫌|きら}われる→嫌う：02048_kirau⟧。
examples.english: Flaunting your knowledge makes people dislike you.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子|こ}ども→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦おもちゃ→おもちゃ：01334_omocha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見|み}せびらかしていた。
examples.english: The child was showing off the new toy to friends.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見|み}せびらかして⟦{自慢|じまん}→自慢：03278_jiman⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was showing off his overseas travel photos to everyone and bragging.

notes:
FORMATION:
Built on ⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧ (to show) plus the bound element ⟦びらかす→びらかす：noentry⟧, which contributes the idea of spreading something out for others to look at. ⟦びらかす→びらかす：noentry⟧ does not occur as a word on its own.

REGISTER:
Always unflattering. The speaker is criticising the display rather than admiring what is displayed — the word carries vanity, boastfulness, and indifference to how the audience feels. Speakers use it of their own behaviour only self-deprecatingly.

COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{財産|ざいさん}→財産：01635_zaisan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見|み}せびらかす — to flaunt wealth
- ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見|み}せびらかす — to show off one's success
- ⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見|み}せびらかす — to show off one's abilities

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自慢|じまん}→自慢：03278_jiman⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is boasting in words; {見|み}せびらかす is boasting by putting the thing itself in front of people.
- ⟦{誇|ほこ}る→誇る：14180_hokoru⟧ is neutral to positive — to be proud of something that genuinely merits pride.
- ⟦{見栄|みえ}→見栄：06626_mie⟧ is the vanity that motivates the behaviour, the noun a speaker reaches for when explaining why someone shows off.
